description.narrative: The project is implemented in Zimbabwe. The main outcome areas it contributes to are advancing equality and workers rights building new alliances and pushing progressive politics. The main rights holders are farm workers, both members and non members, male and female. Through trainings, workshops, mobilizing, organizing, capacity building and materials production and wage negotiations the project aims to achieve an Agriculture Industry with sustainable wages and better living and working conditions.Project OrganisationsThe project is a cooperation between GAPWUZ and The Palme Center. GAPWUZ is a voluntary, democratic and autonomous trade union. It was established to promote, advance and protect the rights and interests of workers in the agriculture industry. It has a membership of just short of 30 000. It is an affiliate to Zimbabwe Congress of Trade Unions, ZCTU. The project is implemented with the support of Kommunal Mitt, a regional branch of The Swedish Municipal Workers Union (Kommunalarbetarefrbundet).Other Donors to the OrganisationHivos Decent work project, Hivos women empowerment project, BWI, IUF OSHE, FOS Belgium, 3F and Afrikagrupperna.Project ObjectiveDecent work for the farm workers. The union want to see a farm worker community where workers are free from all forms of exploitation and victimisation.
